title: Fix Design Scene Mesh Load Crash
description: Nakagin Capsule Tower design at localhost:5173 shows no pieces. Fix split kit assembly to load type/ and design/ sidecar directories.
summary: Design scene no longer crashes when GLB fetch fails during a Vite restart: MeshBody falls back to PlaceholderMesh via MeshLoadErrorBoundary instead of uncaught useGLTF errors killing the WebGL canvas.
